stages.reference: Create a close visual reference for settled natural snow in a bleak grounded dark-fantasy winter. This is an exposed layer that has survived wind, refreezing and passing weather rather than fresh decorative powder. Its surface should feel softly compacted, with delicate wind crust, minute crystalline granularity, shallow uneven settling and subtle blue-gray depth in compressed areas. Keep the snow predominantly muted off-white, allowing cold gray and very restrained blue in shadowed structure. Avoid sparkling holiday snow, giant ice crystals, footprints, dramatic drifts, dirty roadside slush or smooth plastic whiteness. Establish a convincing language of cold, quiet weight and weathered winter exposure. Do not create a landscape composition; concentrate on the physical character of the snow material itself.
